author: Horsfield, 1821
summary: 지금까지 국내 기록이 10건이 안 되는 길잃은새다. 히말라야와 인도 북동부에서 중국 남부, 동남아시아, 자바·발리에 걸쳐 살며, 중국 남부에서 번식하는 무리는 수마트라까지 내려가 겨울을 난다. 숲과 숲 가장자리의 나무 위에서 지내고 이동기에는 맹그로브나 공원에도 나타나며, 꼬리치레류 같은 작은 새의 둥지에 탁란한다.

points.en: tail square-cut to very slightly forked
vent and undertail coverts finely barred white
outermost tail feathers finely barred white below

young: 어른새와 달리 광택이 없는 검은색이고, 머리와 몸, 날개덮깃, 꼬리 끝에 흰 점이 흩어져 있다.

art.subject: Square-tailed Drongo-Cuckoo (Surniculus lugubris), adult: plumage entirely black with a blue-black gloss, strongest on the back and wings; rounded head with no crest, the crown feathers lying flat; undertail coverts barred white; the outer tail feathers barred white on their undersides, so the underside of the long black tail shows narrow white bars. Bill black, slender and slightly decurved; legs short and dark.
art.pose: perched upright on a branch in the mid-canopy, side view
art.scene: Broadleaf woodland edge on a Korean offshore island in May, during spring migration, dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a branch in the mid-canopy: slim, drongo-like cuckoo, glossy bluish-black all over, slender slightly decurved dark bill, pointed wings, long tail square-cut to very slightly forked, vent and undertail coverts finely barred white

adult, front three-quarter view perched, seen from slightly below: glossy bluish-black throat and breast, vent and undertail coverts finely barred white, underside of the long blackish tail showing fine white bars on the outermost feathers
art.build: Slim, drongo-like cuckoo, a little smaller than Black Drongo, perching upright in the mid-canopy; rounded head with no crest. Bill short, slender and slightly decurved, without the heavy hooked tip and bristles of a drongo. Legs short, with two toes forward and two back. Tail long, square-ended or with only a very slight notch at the tip. Wings pointed; flight direct and cuckoo-like.
avoid: Do not paint a deeply forked tail; that marks Black Drongo and Fork-tailed Drongo-Cuckoo.
Do not paint a thick, hooked drongo bill; the bill is thin and slightly curved like a cuckoo's.
Do not omit the white bars under the tail.
Do not paint white spots on the body of the adult; spotting belongs to juveniles.
